requirements.text: Streamline the booking process for customers and staff.
Allow customers to book appointments online at their convenience.
Reduce no-shows through automated reminders via text and email.
Provide barbers with the ability to manage their own schedules.
Gain visibility into daily and weekly bookings to understand peak times and manage workload effectively.
The booking process must allow customers to select their service, barber, and open time slot in one go.
Customers must be able to cancel or reschedule appointments without having to call the shop.
Instant confirmation of appointments must be sent via text and email upon booking.
Real-time availability must be reflected to avoid double bookings.
Customers must be able to create accounts to save their details and preferences.
Automated reminders will be sent 24 hours before the appointment.
A second reminder will be sent one hour before the appointment.
Customers will have the option to receive reminders via both SMS and email.
Barbers should be able to log into the system and set their own availability, including working hours, breaks, and days off.
Barbers should have a simple interface to view their upcoming appointments at a glance.
The system should show real-time availability to customers.
Notifications for barbers regarding new appointments, cancellations, or changes to their schedules.
The solution needs to be cost-effective to implement and maintain.
The system must be easy to learn and use, requiring minimal training for staff.
Compliance with data protection regulations is crucial.
Integration with existing systems (like point-of-sale) would be beneficial.
